calculation.description: For each tradable asset, remove its rolling 60-day beta exposure to the cross-asset median return, then reverse the residual one-day shock. Amplify reversal modestly when observation-only DXY has an unusually large robust standardized daily move. All inputs are lagged through the prior completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (+0.056158, 743 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.048872, 516 dates), and 2025-2027 (+0.030424, 574 dates). Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
